purpose: Mechanism-only teacher-forced gate for the unique final I-39 candidate. It tests whether the AB/first-divergence residual improves the frozen focus margins while remaining close to I-35 step548. It is not an online-score estimator.

candidate_rule.evaluate_only: The unique full 640-step I-39 residual after exact additive concatenation with I-35 step548.

frozen_beam_ledger.allowed_negative_role: I-35 step548 Beam64 candidates are hard negatives only. Gold remains the O3 aligned SID.
frozen_beam_ledger.focus_negative_selection: For each first-divergence row, use every unique ledger hard negative whose first_divergence equals the frozen objective focus index; there are at most four.
frozen_beam_ledger.compatibility_teacher_score_rule: If the raw ledger contains teacher_score, it must exactly equal parent_score and is ignored.

teacher_forced_protocol.positions: Exactly the three logits predicting gold A, B, and C after the frozen video-domain token.
teacher_forced_protocol.gold_metric: Mean teacher-forced log probability of the three gold A/B/C tokens, reported for parent and candidate with paired deltas.
teacher_forced_protocol.focus_margin: For A/B/C first-divergence rows, mean over focus-matched hard negatives of log_p(gold_focus)-log_p(negative_focus).
teacher_forced_protocol.parent_kl: Forward KL(parent || candidate), averaged over the three A/B/C positions.
teacher_forced_protocol.top1: Candidate-to-parent top-1 agreement over the three A/B/C positions; gold top-1 rates are diagnostic only.
teacher_forced_protocol.reporting: Report aggregate, each frozen objective stratum, and the 57 dual-view AB groups with paired parent/candidate metrics.

hard_pass_thresholds.decision_rule: PASS only if every hard threshold passes. No threshold may be changed after observing candidate logits.

next_action: A pass authorizes only downstream package and structural checks. A fail does not authorize checkpoint, scale, or threshold search.
